This '''[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] task force''' was charged with the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], the task force consisted of the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], at least one [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], several [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]] [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]], and several [[Bantha-class troop carrier assault shuttle|''Bantha''-class troop carrier assault shuttles]]. Starfighter support included [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Aggressor Wing]].
